title: Relative outer horn lifting along an equivalence
statement: Use simplicial sets, horns, quasicategories and equivalence edges of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $p:E\to B$ be a simplicial map between small quasicategories, and assume that $p$ is an inner fibration: every commutative square against $\Lambda_i^m\hookrightarrow\Delta^m$, with $m\geq2$ and $0<i<m$, admits a diagonal filler. Let $n\geq2$, let $\beta:\Delta^n\to B$, and let $a:\Lambda_0^n\to E$ satisfy $pa=\beta|_{\Lambda_0^n}$. If $a|_{[0,1]}$ is an equivalence edge in $E$, then there exists $\widetilde\beta:\Delta^n\to E$ with $\widetilde\beta|_{\Lambda_0^n}=a$ and $p\widetilde\beta=\beta$. Dually, if $a:\Lambda_n^n\to E$ lies over $\beta$ and $a|_{[n-1,n]}$ is an equivalence, there is a filler with the same two equalities. No Kan-complex hypothesis on $B$ and no lifting hypothesis on the other outer horns is imposed.

InnerFibration is only the inner-horn lifting condition; quasicategory_of_innerFibration transfers inner-horn filling from the base. The returned hornFilling declarations fill absolute inner horns, and the Quillen declarations assume lifting of all horns. Ordinary-category cocartesian and bicategorical Kan declarations have different objects. None gives relative outer-horn lifting along an equivalence edge. The second semantic phrasing returns strict-Segal/quasicategory and truncated-homotopy definitions, not this lifting assertion.
